footnote_text: This Form 4/A amends the Reporting Person's Form 4 filed on February 24, 2026 to correct the amount reported in Table I, Column 5, which inadvertently omitted 751,879 shares underlying restricted stock units granted September 22, 2025 and reported on the September 24, 2025 Form 4. The corrected balance following the February 20, 2026 transaction is 120,113,079, including those restricted stock units. The transaction information is otherwise unchanged, no new grant or transaction is reported. All amounts are on a pre-reverse-split basis. Subsequent Forms 4 filed by the Reporting Person through the date of this amendment should be read to incorporate this correction in the context of the transactions reported. Accordingly, Forms 4 filed from February 24, 2026 through October 15, 2026 understated beneficial ownership following each reported transaction in Table I, Column 5 by 751,879 shares of common stock.
